```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

## Read the inputs

The cases CSV contains one row per selected resurgence. Each case has a
unique ID and a confirmed Billboard chart week within the run described
by the article. Enter dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`. If the source provides only
the original release year, leave the release date blank. Leave the trigger
blank when the article gives none.

```{r read-inputs}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

song_key <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub('^[“"]|[”"]$', "", x)
  x <- gsub("[‘’]", "'", x)
  tolower(trimws(x))
}

billboard <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed/billboard_combined.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    chart_date = col_date(),
    chart_position = col_integer(),
    song_title = col_character(),
    artist_name = col_character()
  )
)

cases_path <- "../data/processed/verified_resurgence_cases.csv"

cases <- read_csv(
  cases_path,
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    confirmed_week = col_date(),
    original_release_date = col_date(),
    original_release_year = col_integer()
  )
)

stop_for_problems(billboard)
stop_for_problems(cases)

if (nrow(cases) != 15L) {
  stop(
    "Expected 15 cases, but read ", nrow(cases), " from ",
    normalizePath(cases_path),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(cases$case_id),
  all(nzchar(trimws(cases$case_id))),
  anyDuplicated(cases$case_id) == 0L,
  !anyNA(cases$confirmed_week)
)

cases <- cases |>
  mutate(
    title_key = song_key(song_title),
    artist_key = song_key(artist_name)
  )
```

## Match cases to Billboard

Join on normalized song title and artist. Start a new run when the gap
between chart appearances differs from seven days. Keep the run containing
each case’s confirmed chart week.

```{r join-billboard}
billboard_keys <- billboard |>
  filter(!is.na(chart_date)) |>
  transmute(
    title_key = song_key(song_title),
    artist_key = song_key(artist_name),
    chart_date,
    chart_position
  )

case_weeks <- cases |>
  inner_join(
    billboard_keys,
    by = c("title_key", "artist_key"),
    na_matches = "never",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

duplicate_weeks <- case_weeks |>
  count(case_id, chart_date) |>
  filter(n > 1L)

if (nrow(duplicate_weeks) > 0L) {
  print(duplicate_weeks)
  stop("Resolve duplicate Billboard weeks for the listed cases.")
}

case_weeks <- case_weeks |>
  group_by(case_id) |>
  arrange(chart_date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    starts_new_run = is.na(lag(chart_date)) |
      as.integer(chart_date - lag(chart_date)) != 7L,
    run_id = cumsum(starts_new_run)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

anchor_runs <- case_weeks |>
  filter(chart_date == confirmed_week) |>
  select(case_id, run_id)

unmatched_cases <- cases |>
  anti_join(anchor_runs, by = "case_id") |>
  select(case_id, song_title, artist_name, confirmed_week)

if (nrow(unmatched_cases) > 0L) {
  print(unmatched_cases)
  stop("Verify the song, artist, and confirmed chart week for the listed cases.")
}

resurgence_weeks <- case_weeks |>
  semi_join(anchor_runs, by = c("case_id", "run_id"))
```

## Check the matched chart weeks

Compare the matched weeks with the article’s reported period and Westin’s
tracker. Check any uncertain boundaries against the available chart data.

```{r check-join}
tibble(
  cases_before_join = nrow(cases),
  chart_rows_after_join = nrow(case_weeks),
  chart_rows_in_resurgence = nrow(resurgence_weeks)
)

resurgence_weeks |>
  select(case_id, song_title, confirmed_week, chart_date, chart_position)
```

## Summarize and save the working merge

Peak rank is the lowest numerical rank in the matched run. Weeks charted
counts distinct chart dates. Age is measured from the original release date
to the start of the run and rounded to one decimal. Age remains missing
when only the release year is available. Check the 10-year cutoff
separately using the verified release information and the run start.

```{r save-working-merge}
run_summary <- resurgence_weeks |>
  group_by(case_id) |>
  summarise(
    resurgence_start = min(chart_date),
    resurgence_end = max(chart_date),
    peak_rank = if (all(is.na(chart_position))) {
      NA_integer_
    } else {
      min(chart_position, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    weeks_charted = n_distinct(chart_date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case_summary <- cases |>
  select(-title_key, -artist_key) |>
  left_join(run_summary, by = "case_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    age_at_resurgence_years = round(
      as.numeric(resurgence_start - original_release_date) / 365.25,
      1
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(case_summary) == nrow(cases),
  !anyNA(case_summary$resurgence_start)
)

case_summary |>
  select(
    case_id, resurgence_start, resurgence_end,
    peak_rank, weeks_charted, age_at_resurgence_years
  ) |>
  print(width = Inf)

write_csv(case_summary, "../data/processed/resurgence_pilot.csv")
```
